{{Short description|Russian-French mathematical physicist (1948–2024)}}
'''Dmitri R. Yafaev''' (Дмитрий Рауэльевич Яфаев;<ref>{{cite web|title=Дмитрий Рауэльевич Яфаев|website=Кафедра Высшей Математики и Математической Физики, Санкт-Петербургский Государственный Университет, Физический Факультет (math.nw.ru)|url=http://math.nw.ru/wp/?p=1780|access-date=2019-10-30|archive-date=2021-01-10|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210110154431/http://math.nw.ru/wp/?p=1780|url-status=dead}}</ref> 2 January 1948 – 16 June 2024) was a Russian-French mathematical physicist.<ref name=CV>{{cite web|title=Dmitri Yafaev: Curriculum Vitae|website=math.nw.ru|url=http://math.nw.ru/wp/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/CV_London.pdf}}</ref>

At the [[University of Leningrad]] (now renamed Saint Petersburg State University) Yafaev received his Russian Candidate degree (Ph.D.) in 1973 with thesis advisor [[Mikhail Birman]]<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=74086}}</ref> and was a lecturer from 1973 to 1977. From 1977 to 1990 Yafaev was a researcher and senior researcher at the St. Petersburg Branch of the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]]. At the [[University of Nantes]] he was an associate professor from 1990 to 1992. From 1992 he was a full professor at the [[University of Rennes 1]].<ref name=CV/>

Yafaev's research deals with "spectral theory of differential operators; spectral properties of scattering matrices; long-range scattering theory; magnetic Hamiltonians". He is the author of three books and numerous articles. He was on the editorial boards of several journals, including ''[[Integral Equations and Operator Theory]]''.<ref name=CV/>

He was an invited speaker in 1998 of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Berlin<ref>{{cite book|author=Yafaev, D.|chapter=Scattering theory: Some old and new problems|title=Doc. Math. (Bielefeld) Extra Vol. ICM Berlin, 1998, vol. III|year=1998|pages=87–96|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011566000}}</ref> and in 2003 at the 14th [[International Congress on Mathematical Physics]] in Lisbon.<ref name="Yafaev2006">{{cite book|editor=Zambrini Jean-Claude|title=XIVth International Congress On Mathematical Physics|last1=Yafaev|first1=D. R.|chapter=A particle in the Bio-Savart-Laplace magnetic field: explicit solutions|year=2006|pages=626–633|doi=10.1142/9789812704016_0064|publisher=World Scientific|isbn=978-981-4480-76-5|s2cid=119448159|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=oObICgAAQBAJ}}</ref>

Yafaev died on 16 June 2024, at the age of 76.<ref>[https://mph.phys.spbu.ru/?p=3307 Печальное известие] {{in lang|ru}}</ref>
